## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what a user sees after this change.

## Verification

List the exact commands, scope and results. Say which checks were not run and why.

## Screenshots

For visible changes, show before/after using a synthetic project only.

## Data, compatibility and risk

Describe relevant source preservation, queue/index behavior, retries, format compatibility and rollback considerations.

## Review checks

- [ ] The change is focused and includes a regression test where practical.
- [ ] Private notes, credentials, local configuration, model weights and generated output are absent.
- [ ] Documentation and interface translations were updated where needed.
- [ ] New third-party code or assets include origin, license and required notices.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the repository's stated terms.
